data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fazala' which means 'to be beautiful, delightful, or graceful'. The name Faazila embodies the essence of inner and outer beauty in Islam. The name Faazila carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faazila usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
